selection: Minimum validation loss checkpoint; assessment is read only after model selection
order: replicate index ascending, world lexicographic, B1 then B2
purpose: Exploratory check of a longer fixed optimization budget with fresh independent data and model seeds
interpretation: No hypothesis, equivalence, novelty, power guarantee or Cycle resolution; these data never enter confirmatory evidence
failure_policy: One attempt after separate approval; preserve partial failure; no retries, extension or complete-stage summary on failure
